description: This file contains implementation of big number multiplication and squaring functions, including recursive and optimized algorithms, for cryptographic use in the BoringSSL library.

methods.name: bn_abs_sub_words
methods.description: Performs absolute subtraction of two multi-word numbers with sign handling.

methods.name: bn_mul_normal
methods.description: Performs normal multiplication of two multi-word numbers.

methods.name: bn_sub_part_words
methods.description: Subtracts parts of multi-word numbers with length and delta parameters.

methods.name: bn_abs_sub_part_words
methods.description: Computes absolute difference of parts of multi-word numbers with sign mask.

methods.name: bn_mul_recursive
methods.description: Implements Karatsuba recursive multiplication for large numbers.

methods.name: bn_mul_part_recursive
methods.description: Performs recursive multiplication on parts of large numbers.

methods.name: bn_sqr_normal
methods.description: Performs normal squaring of a multi-word number.

methods.name: BN_mul_word
methods.description: Multiplies a BIGNUM by a single word.

methods.name: bn_sqr_consttime
methods.description: Performs constant-time squaring of a BIGNUM.

methods.name: bn_sqr_small
methods.description: Squares small fixed-size arrays of words.
